title: Cradle By PARJ4
body:
Coming form the wonderfull book series Cradle By Will Wight, 'Cradle By PARJ4' Gives You The Best Experience within Minecraft to feel like your in the world of cradle. Use your core and follow one of many paths. Use Blackflame to destory your enemies, follow the stellar spear to speedaly kill your fows and poison them with sandviper venom. "There are a million Paths in this world, but any sage will tell you they can all be reduced to one. Improve yourself." 


Required Mods: [Kleinders Custom Render API,](https://modrinth.com/mod/kleiders-custom-renderer-api/versions?g=1.20.1&l=forge) [Geckolib](https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib/versions?g=1.20.1&l=forge)

NOTE THIS IS BETA AND NOT ALL THINGS ARE FINISHED AND THERE ARE BUGS
